metadata.case_name: WAN YING SHEUNG v. WAN YIU KAN

injuries.description: comminuted fracture of left lateral tibia plateau with depressed contour involving both medial and lateral tibial spines with small loosened body fragments in the tibiofemoral joint space near midline.
source: comminuted fracture of left lateral tibia plateau with depressed contour involving both medial and lateral tibial spines with small loosened body fragments in the tibiofemoral joint space near midline.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of tibia, lateral condyle
Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

injuries.description: PTSD with depressive features in direct consequence of the Accident and related aftermath
source: PTSD with depressive features in direct consequence of the Accident and related aftermath

manifestations.description: walking difficulty; walked with a frame indoors and required a wheelchair outdoors
left knee pain (including pain at night and with prolonged standing/walking)
left knee stiffness; reduced left knee range of motion (examples recorded: 0°–90°, 5°–90°, 0°–95°, 5°–90° across records)
weakness of left knee/quadriceps and slight muscle wasting of left thigh
marked osteoporosis of left knee indicative of chronic disuse
inability to negotiate stairs and inability to squat; difficulty in toileting and in putting on lower garments and shoes
on-and-off left knee swelling and crepitus
nightmares/flashbacks of the Accident, hypervigilance, avoidance of the site of the Accident and avoidance of travelling in taxis; fear and avoidance complaints
depressed mood, impaired sleep and appetite, loss of energy and interest, transient suicidal ideas
emotional distress and tearfulness when discussing pain and disability; limited insight

treatments_received: open reduction and plating to left tibial fracture (operation performed on 2006-11-01)
physiotherapy: 47 sessions between 12 January 2007 and 28 November 2007
implant removal (operation performed on 2008-07-07) with hospitalisation of 8 days
psychiatric treatment including medication and psychotherapy in the public sector; clinical psychologist interventions and social worker referral
treatments_future: left total knee replacement (suggested; patient reluctant and later declined)

losses.description: Walked with a frame indoors and required a wheelchair outdoors; could not negotiate stairs or squat; needed assistance for outdoor mobility

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Could not perform any home management tasks such as homemaking, cooking and preparing food, which were being done by her daughters
Totally dependent in respect of community living skills and required assistance (eg Rehabus, carers) for hospital consultations and ADL
ADL and social life highly affected; homebound for major part of a year post-Accident, reduced social and recreational activities

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Fear and avoidance of travelling in taxis, crossing the road and the site of the Accident; avoids being seen and seldom goes out
PTSD with depressive features in direct consequence of the Accident and related aftermath
